description.narrative: The purpose of the Grant is to support the Recipient's efforts to realize the objectives of the Partnership to Support the Reform of Governance in Indonesia, a collaborative partnership of representatives of the Government of Indonesia, members of Indonesian civil society and the international donor community established in 2000. The activities for which the Grant is given are as follows: (a) engaging technical assistance for the development and implementation of Governance Partnership work programs, (b) carrying out seminars and workshops in furtherance of Governance Partnership objectives and as part of the its work programs, (c) preparing and dissemination knowledge materials in connection with the Partnership, and (d) engaging technical assistance for the development and maintenance of a monitoring framework and databases to track progress in the attainment of governance objectives.
